scope.base: caller-scoped current worktree including new files

intent: Provide a multi-turn text-to-synthetic-audio Doubao console lab with simulated tools, manual reply playback, per-turn feedback, and JSON/Markdown/ZIP export. Preserve records on refresh; stop and erase on privacy; prevent microphone input and competing device tests.

findings.title: Handle session failures between turns
findings.suggested_fix: Handle error events before the no-current-turn guard; mark the lab errored and close/release its failed session while preserving exportable records.
findings.why_it_matters: A receive failure between turns leaves the UI ready and device ownership retained; a subsequent input can wait against a failed session until timeout.
evidence: RealtimeSession._task_done sets failed=True and emits error; feed rejects failed sessions.
The lab ignores this event without _current; ordinary watchdog only eventually closes the session.

findings.title: Stop audio before removing cleared records
findings.suggested_fix: Dispose removed cards by pausing audio, removing src, calling load(), cancelling timers, and removing DOM; share cleanup with clearSensitive.
findings.first_evidence: device/lira/ui/static/dev-doubao-lab.js:98 -- for (const [id, card] of cards) if (!ids.has(id)) { clearTimeout(card.timer); card.root.remove(); cards.delete(id); }
findings.why_it_matters: If another browser clears records while a reply is playing, removing the audio DOM node alone can leave playback running and makes later cleanup unable to reach it.
evidence: The removed-record branch never pauses or unloads audio.
clearSensitive only iterates remaining cards, so removed playing elements are no longer reachable there.
